description: General facts for the Aetherium Guide (General section and FAQ), one record per fact. status: confirmed (seen in game by Miguel), reported (from the cited source, not tested by us), pending (not known yet: the page says so). Every record carries its provenance; the pages cite each source by its url. Facts are in our own words; no text, image or code is copied from any source.

records.label: Global launch
records.text: The global servers opened with Advanced Access on 30 September 2026. The full launch followed on 5 October 2026.

records.label: Elyos
records.text: The Elyos are the Daevas of light. When the Tower of Aion fell and the Balaur poured into their home of Elysea, their Empyrean Lords gave themselves up to raise a wall of light that sealed the realm away. Siel was lost holding it.

records.label: Asmodians
records.text: The Asmodians are the Daevas of shadow. When the barrier fell, Asmodae lay open to the Balaur. With Israphel gone, their five remaining Empyrean Lords spent everything to raise the Bulwark that shields their realm.

records.label: Picking a faction
records.text: You pick Elyos or Asmodian when you make a character and cannot change it. The two factions play on separate servers and only meet in the Abyss, so they cannot party together. A Legion only takes members of one faction. To play with friends, pick the same faction and server.

records.label: The story so far
lines: The war between Elyos and Asmodians ended when the Tower of Aion collapsed. That last battle is remembered as the Final War.

With the tower gone, the Dragonkin (the Balaur) broke into the realms of the gods. The surviving gods used the last of their power to raise a barrier, the Veil of Light, which split the world and cut it off.
Building it cost them dearly: Siel, guardian of the tower, vanished, and the other Archdeities poured themselves into it until some were destroyed and others faded.
Outside the barrier, Atreia became a battlefield. The Dragon Lords Ishtar and Fafnir burned and darkened Poeta.
Daevas were hunted and twisted. Under Ishtar, captured Daevas were experimented on and came back as mutants that turn on their own kind. This is the world your Daeva wakes up in.

records.label: Season 1
records.text: Season 1 on the global servers (EU and NA) caps at Lv 45. Korea is at Lv 50, so Korean guides past Lv 45 do not apply here. Season 1 has no Heroic items and gives 415 Daevanion points to spend.

provenance.title: Dungeon livestream confirms level cap of 45
Gladiator skill builds 9181 and 10896, Daevanion builds 3576 and 5406

records.label: Reset times
records.text: The daily reset is at 07:00 UTC every day. The weekly reset is on Wednesday at 07:00 UTC.
notes: Your local time for a reset moves by an hour when your clocks change for summer time; the UTC time does not.
Hover over an entry counter in game to see how long until it recharges.

records.label: Entries shared by server
records.text: Some entry counts, such as Daily Dungeon entries, are shared by every character on the same server. Using them on an alt also uses them up for your main there.

records.label: Trading
records.text: Direct trading between players is turned off on the global servers, to stop bots. You buy and sell through the Market instead.

records.label: Membership
records.text: The Market and the Quna Exchange need Special Quai Membership. Membership is bought for one character on one server, not for the whole account, so put it on the character you play most. The Daeva Pass is also bought per character.

records.label: Buying for less
records.text: In the Market, sort by price per unit, not by the price of the whole stack. A big stack can look cheap and still cost more for each item.

records.label: Control modes

modes.name: AION2
modes.text: Action controls. The mouse turns the camera and the reticle in the middle of the screen picks your target. Hold Alt to see the cursor.

modes.name: AION1
modes.text: Classic MMO controls. The cursor is always on screen, you hold a mouse button to turn the camera and click to pick a target. Handy for healers who watch party frames.

records.text: There are two control modes and you can swap at any time: AION2 (the default, action style) and AION1 (classic, cursor always on).

records.label: Default keys

keys: Potion auto use on or off

held.reason: The wiki lists Space as jump and glide; Miguel has Defiance on Space bar in game. Not shown until Miguel rules which the guide should say.

records.text: The defaults from the global client. Every key can be changed.

records.label: Key Settings

tabs: Moving, combat, flying and other actions
Keys that open windows and menus

records.text: Change keys in Settings, Key Settings. It has four tabs, and each tab has its own Reset button that only resets that tab.

records.label: Menus with no key
records.text: Expedition, Daily Dungeon, Nightmare, Transcendence, Shugo Festival, Abyss, Arena and the Market have no key by default. Give the ones you open often a key in Settings, Key Settings, Menu.

records.label: Defiance on Space bar
records.text: Every class has Defiance, the skill that breaks crowd control, on Space bar. It never takes a number key.

provenance.note: Defiance sits on Space bar for every class.

records.label: How the skill bar is laid out
lines: The bar reads 1 to 8, Q, E, then left click (your main attack), right click (your main line) and a second macro stack.
Own keys fill 1 to 4 first, because those sit right above Q and E where your fingers rest. Then Q and E, then 5 to 8.
A key that holds a stack of skills goes on Q or E: they are easier to reach while you move than 5 to 8.
Each key holds up to four skills in rows 0 to 3. Press it and the lowest ready skill fires, row 0 first.
The two stacks either side of your main attack are the only entries in your macro.

provenance.note: Own keys fill 1 to 4 (right above Q and E), then Q and E, then 5 to 8; stacked keys go on Q and E.

provenance.where: Skill bar and Macro window, Templar
provenance.note: The right-hand block holds stack A, the main attack, stack B. Macro 1 has two entries, stack A and stack B, 10 ms delay each.
Four rows on a key, row 0 at the bottom, the key fires the lowest ready skill.

records.label: Macros
records.text: There is one macro key and 3 macro presets. Hold the key and the macro uses its skills in order; any skill you press by hand goes first. To change preset you open the Macro window, as there is only one key. In AION1 mode a mouse button cannot be the macro key.

provenance.note: Macro slots 1 to 3, entries numbered with a Delay (ms) box between each pair, 10 ms by default.

records.label: Targeting
records.text: Tab locks the target in front of you. In big fights, give Target Hostile Players its own key (for example the middle mouse button) in Settings, Key Settings, General, so Tab does not grab NPCs.

records.label: Mouse and camera
records.text: There is no mouse sensitivity slider: set the horizontal and vertical camera speeds in Settings, Graphics, Camera/Direction. The game cannot invert the mouse.

records.label: Controller
records.text: A controller works but is not officially supported, and you cannot change its buttons. It will not work through Steam Remote Play, Steam Link or cloud PCs, because the anti-cheat blocks outside input.

records.label: Loadouts
records.text: Each character has 3 loadouts for looks, 3 for armour and 3 for skills. You can keep, for example, a damage set and a tank set and swap between them.

provenance.note: Three loadout options each for character looks, armour (gear) and skills.

records.label: Loadouts in the Aetherium
lines: The official AION 2 site only shows what your Daeva is wearing and using right now, so the Daeva Card and Gear Ledger show that one set.
The Ascent Plan builds one role at a time. Switch the Role on the plan to work out each of your loadouts, for example damage on one and tank on another.
Each macro preset belongs to its skill setup, so set the macro up again on every skill loadout you use.

provenance.note: Plan for up to 3 setups per Daeva; the armory data only shows what is equipped now.

records.label: Potions used for you
records.text: Life Potions are used for you below 70% HP. Lower the threshold in Settings, Combat, Auto Use if you get through too many while questing. X turns it on and off.

records.label: Looting filter
records.text: Pick which grades and kinds of item the loot key picks up in Settings, Combat, Looting, so low value items stay out of your bag (the Cube).

records.label: Auto Extract
records.text: Auto Extract breaks down equipment of the grades you choose as soon as it drops. It can also take gear you cannot wear or gear under an item level you set. Quick Select marks many items so you can extract them in one go.

records.label: Lock your gear
records.text: The extract, dismantle and enhance windows look alike, so it is easy to lose a good piece with one wrong click. Lock the weapons and accessories you care about straight away.

records.label: Flying further
records.text: Collecting more wings raises your Flight Power, and owned wings count even when you are not wearing them. To glide further, cancel flight in the air right after a Quick Gliding Dash: you keep your speed as you fall.

records.label: Characters per account
records.text: An account starts with 4 character slots and can grow to 8. Some settings are kept per character, so check them after you switch.

records.label: First steps
lines: Check the official Steam news or Discord for maintenance first.
Restart the game and the launcher.
Make sure both are fully updated.
Check your internet connection.
See if the problem is on one character or the whole account.
Look at the related setting in game again.

records.label: Error codes

codes: Not an error. Reinstalling does not help: stay in the queue.
The server is busy. Close the game and launcher fully, wait, then try again rather than pressing Retry over and over.
Reconnect failed. Log in again; a wired connection helps.
A login error. Stop asking for new codes, update PURPLE, set your PC clock to automatic, then wait.
The anti-cheat is blocking a program hooked into the game. Remove npcap (it comes with some damage meters and Wireshark) and close macro, RGB lighting and remote control tools.
Often a second copy of the game is still running. End every AION2.exe in Task Manager and restart Steam.
Update your graphics driver, then use Verify integrity of game files in Steam. Turn off overlays, recorders and RGB tools one at a time.

records.label: Known problems

items: Chat says Please Try Again Later
A known bug. Switch character, go through a loading screen or log in again.
Happens if you opened the Duty tab before Lv 45. They come back the next day.
Not a bug: the game logs you out to server select after 3 hours with no input.
You probably pressed F12. Press it again.

records.text: Problems many players hit, and the fix.

records.label: Reporting a problem
lines: Write down the exact message or code.
Note when and where it happened.
Note your platform and the settings involved.
Report bugs in the official Discord bug report channel. For account problems, contact NC support.

records.label: Mastery cap
records.text: Mastery takes a skill to Lv 11 at most. Levels above 11 come from Daevanion skill nodes (+1 each), gear stat lines and Arcana.

provenance.note: Mastery stops at skill Lv 11. Levels above 11 come from Daevanion skill nodes (+1 each), gear stat lines and Arcana.

provenance.title: Skills guide: active, passive and stigma

records.label: Skill nodes on the Daevanion boards
records.text: Each core skill has one +1 level node on each of the first four Daevanion boards: Nezekan, Zikel, Vaizel and Triniel. The fifth board, Azphel, has none.

records.label: Specialty perks
lines: Every active skill has 5 Specialty perks.
Skill Lv 8 opens three perks and your first perk slot.
Skill Lv 12 opens a fourth perk and a second slot.
Skill Lv 16 opens the fifth perk.
Skill Lv 20 opens the third slot, so you use three of the five.
records.test: Open a skill in the Mastery window and check at which skill levels its perks and perk slots open.

provenance.title: Skills guide: active, passive and stigma

records.label: Stigmas

value.quest: The One Who Hears the Voice

records.text: Stigmas open at Lv 22 through the quest The One Who Hears the Voice. You get one stigma slot at Lv 22 and one more at Lv 27, 32 and 37, four in all. Stigma Specialty perks open at stigma Lv 5, 10, 15 and 20.

records.label: How skills level up

value.reason: One Korean guide says Wisdom Stones take a skill to Lv 10; Miguel saw Mastery reach Lv 11 in game. Which item levels skills, and its cap, needs checking in game.

records.text: Skills are raised in the Mastery window. What it costs to level a skill is not confirmed for the global servers yet.

provenance.title: Skills guide: active, passive and stigma

records.q: I cannot see my mouse cursor.
records.a: Hold Alt to show it, or switch to AION1 mode, where the cursor is always on screen.

records.q: How do I change my keys?
records.a: Open Settings, Key Settings. The General, Menu, Quickslot and Marker tabs hold every key.

records.q: Expedition and Nightmare have no key. Can I add one?
records.a: Yes. Give them a key in Settings, Key Settings, Menu.

records.q: Where should Defiance go?
records.a: On Space bar, for every class. It breaks crowd control, so keep it off your number keys.

provenance.note: Defiance sits on Space bar for every class.

records.q: Can I swap macro presets with a key?
records.a: No. There is one macro key, so open the Macro window to change between your 3 presets.

records.q: Skill use requirements not met keeps popping up with my macro.
records.a: You cannot move or hide that message. A slightly longer delay between macro skills makes it show less often.

records.q: My whole UI disappeared.
records.a: You pressed F12. Press it again. If it keeps happening, move Hide UI to another key.

records.q: My FPS is stuck at 60.
records.a: Set the Screen Refresh Rate to your monitor's highest and turn Vertical Sync off.

records.q: How do I see the map while I play?
records.a: Press Alt + M for a see-through map over the game. Press it again to close it.

records.q: How do I hide my helmet?
records.a: In the Closet, click the eye icon next to your helmet.

records.q: Too many numbers cover the boss attacks.
records.a: Hide damage numbers by type, or all of them, in Settings, Info Display, Floater.

records.q: Potions get used in the middle of a fight.
records.a: They are used below 70% HP by default. Change the threshold in Settings, Combat, Auto Use, or press X to turn it off.

records.q: My bag keeps filling with junk.
records.a: Set the Looting filter and turn on Auto Extract for the grades you do not want.

records.q: I lost a good item to extraction.
records.a: Lock the gear you care about in your inventory: the extract, dismantle and enhance windows look alike.

records.q: Why can I not trade with another player?
records.a: Direct trading is turned off on the global servers. Use the Market, which needs Membership.

records.q: Does Membership cover my whole account?
records.a: No. It is bought for one character on one server.

records.q: When are the resets?
records.a: Daily at 07:00 UTC, weekly on Wednesday at 07:00 UTC. The Reset times page shows them in your own time.

records.q: Can Elyos and Asmodians group up?
records.a: No. They play on separate servers and only meet in the Abyss.

records.q: How do I invite someone nearby to my party?
records.a: Hold Alt, click their character and pick the party invite. A party holds 5 players and a raid 10.

records.q: I cannot heal players in the open world.
records.a: Heals only work on party members, so make a party first.

records.q: Why do my Daily Dungeon entries drop when I play an alt?
records.a: Some entry counts are shared by every character on the same server.

records.q: What is the level cap?
records.a: Lv 45 on the global servers in Season 1. Guides for Korea go to Lv 50 and do not apply past 45.

provenance.title: Dungeon livestream confirms level cap of 45

records.q: The game will not start.
records.a: Most crashes come from clashes with other programs. Look up the error code on the Troubleshooting part of the General section.

records.q: Chat says Please Try Again Later.
records.a: A known bug. Switch character, go through a loading screen or log in again.

records.q: I keep getting sent back to server select.
records.a: After 3 hours with no input the game returns you there. It is not a bug.
